targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${prefix}-inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pv1_w" or r["_field"] == "pv2_w")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.pv1_w + r.pv2_w}))

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${prefix}-inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "grid_w" or r["_field"] == "feed_in_w")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.grid_w - r.feed_in_w}))

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${prefix}-inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "feed_in_w")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "metrics")
